notes.title: A Major Update for The Sisyphus Journey. The Awakening
notes.content: [p]Emptiness... Emptiness demands transformation. The world must begin to breathe anew... The world must awaken...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524174/7e39fa0f1499c5ed39af3b3522dee0e22b7fa69b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]The Awakening:[/h2][p][/p][p]Now, your persistence matters even more. The world is no longer static: at first, it will greet you with a cold, black-and-white void. But your every effort, every conversation, and every decision made will literally breathe life into it, returning colors, sounds, and new inhabitants. You will see the desolate landscape blossom before your eyes, reflecting your inner progress.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's new in update  "The Awakening":[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New "Living World" Mechanic:[/b] Begin your journey in monochrome despair and watch as the world around you fills with color and detail in response to your actions and interactions with characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Completely Updated Graphics and Animations:[/b] I have redrawn many assets, added effects like swaying trees in the wind, and made many other changes to make the world feel deeper.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Minimalist Interface:[/b] The entire UI has been redesigned to be cleaner, more intuitive, and less distracting from the contemplative process.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fast Travel:[/b] I've heard your feedback! Now, after discovering a new location, you can instantly travel between it and the base camp to give the finger holding down the movement key a little rest.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524174/ffba9c96fa0b6ccfceec533f17881808e7383611.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This update is a big step forward for the game, and I hope it will make your eternal journey even more meaningful and memorable. Thank you for your support and feedback. The path to the summit continues![/p][p]Sincerely, Escapismo.[/p][p][/p][h3]Attention! To enjoy the new version, please delete your old save files.[/h3]

tags.feature: [b]New "Living World" Mechanic:[/b] Begin your journey in monochrome despair and watch as the world around you fills with color and detail in response to your actions and interactions with characters.
[b]Completely Updated Graphics and Animations:[/b] I have redrawn many assets, added effects like swaying trees in the wind, and made many other changes to make the world feel deeper.
[b]New Minimalist Interface:[/b] The entire UI has been redesigned to be cleaner, more intuitive, and less distracting from the contemplative process.

[b]Fast Travel:[/b] I've heard your feedback! Now, after discovering a new location, you can instantly travel between it and the base camp to give the finger holding down the movement key a little rest.

notes.title: "The Sisyphus Journey" Demo Updated Before Release!
notes.content:
Greetings, future conquerors of the summit!

The release of "The Sisyphus Journey" is getting closer – the game launches on April 23rd! As part of the final preparations, I've introduced a number of improvements and fixes, and I'm happy to announce that I've updated the demo version so you can evaluate the latest changes.

What's new in the demo:

[list]
[*] Localization: Added support for Simplified Chinese.
[*] Story and Dialogues: Dialogue texts have been reworked and improved.
[*] Visual Improvements: I've updated the graphics, refined the weather effects, and added detail to some environmental elements.
[*] Animations: The stone interaction animation has been slightly adjusted.
[/list]

I invite you to try out the updated demo version right now!

I would be very grateful for your feedback and impressions. There's still a little time before release to add the final touches based on your feedback. Thank you for being with me on this journey!
